title: OpenAPI Client Generator
description: Generate an OpenAPI client library from an OpenAPI spec file

name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the library? (e.g. my-api)

directory.description: Directory where the library will be created

scope.x-prompt: What is the scope of the project? (e.g. @my-org)

spec.description: Path to the OpenAPI spec file (URL or local path)
spec.x-prompt: What is the path to the OpenAPI spec file? (URI or local file path)

client.description: The type of client to generate (@hey-api/client-fetch, @hey-api/client-axios, etc). Pin a version with e.g. @hey-api/client-fetch@1.x.x

plugins.description: The plugins to be provided to @hey-api/openapi-ts

tags.description: Tags to add to the library (comma-separated). Specifying this option replaces the defaults

private.description: Whether to make the generated package private. Set to false if you want to publish the package

asClass.description: Whether to use the class style for the generated code. Currently not working

baseTsConfigName.description: The name of the base tsconfig file that contains the compiler paths used to resolve the imports. Use this if the base tsconfig file is in the workspace root. If provided with a baseTsConfigPath then the baseTsConfigName will be added to the path. Do not use this if the baseTsConfigPath is a file

baseTsConfigPath.description: The path to the base tsconfig file that contains the compiler paths used to resolve the imports. Use this if the base tsconfig file is not in the workspace root. This can be a file or a directory. If it is a directory and the baseTsConfigName is provided then the baseTsConfigName will be added to the path. If it is a file and the baseTsConfigName is provided then there will be an error

serveCmdName.description: The command name used to serve the implicit dependencies when watching for spec changes. Defaults to `serve`

projectReferences.description: Whether to add TypeScript project references for the generated project

useInferredTasks.description: Whether to use Nx inferred tasks instead of explicit targets. When true, the generator will only create minimal project configuration and rely on the plugin to infer targets from openapi-ts.config.*. Requires the plugin to be registered in nx.json
